## 📋 Pull Request Checklist

### Type of Change:
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Security improvement
- [ ] Dependency update

### ✅ Security & Quality Checks:
- [ ] My code follows the repository security guidelines
- [ ] No credentials, API keys, or secrets are included in this PR
- [ ] I have reviewed my own code for potential issues
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes locally
- [ ] `npm test` passes locally
- [ ] `npm audit` shows no HIGH or CRITICAL vulnerabilities
- [ ] Documentation updated where needed

### What does this change do?
Brief description:

### Related Issue:
Closes #

### ⚠️ Special Attention:
- [ ] Changes workflow files (`.github/workflows/`) → Requires DevOps review
- [ ] Changes dependencies (`package.json`, `package-lock.json`) → Security review runs automatically
- [ ] Changes environment variables or config templates → Check `.env.example` updated
